description: Use this when the user asks what a couple usually does by when, for a wedding date. Zola's general planning timeline template, dated: the planning milestones for a wedding date and a wedding format (traditional, small, destination, elopement, or courthouse). Each milestone has a start date and a due date, counted back from the wedding date, and a status relative to today: late, now, later, or after the wedding. A milestone that applies only in some cases, for example a honeymoon, is marked optional. Do not use for the hour-by-hour schedule of the wedding day (use zola_get_wedding_day_timeline_template). Do not use for the couple's own tasks or progress: use zola_get_my_checklist or zola_get_my_planning_overview.

format.description: Wedding format. The default is traditional.

wedding_date.description: Wedding date, YYYY-MM-DD. From today to 5 years after today.

name: zola_get_planning_timeline_template

milestones.description: The milestones of the format, late and now first, then by due date

applies_if.description: When an optional milestone applies, for example 'if you plan a honeymoon'

category.description: basics, vendors, guests, paper, legal, attire, travel, or after

due_date.description: End of the usual window, YYYY-MM-DD

id.description: Stable milestone ID, for example M07

key.description: Stable milestone key, for example book-venue

optional.description: True when the milestone applies only in some cases

start_date.description: Start of the usual window, YYYY-MM-DD

status.description: late: the due date is before today. now: today is in the window. later: the window starts after today. after: the window is after the wedding.

today.description: The day that the statuses are relative to, YYYY-MM-DD (UTC)

title: Get Wedding Planning Timeline Template
